qa_pair.question: Exactly one product in the ledger passes every launch gate — score threshold, evidence, suppliers, compliance and unit economics. What is that product's break-even ROAS?

One product scores above 80 out of 100 but is still not launch ready, and it is blocked by exactly one gate. Expressed as a percentage to one decimal place, what is that product's pre-ad contribution margin?
Only one of the three categories fails its evidence gate. What is the name of that category?
One product carries a compliance verdict of EXCLUDE. What is its name?
South Africa is recorded as the beachhead market, but it does not have the highest market score. Which market scores highest?

Ignoring any product whose compliance verdict is EXCLUDE, exactly one remaining product breaches the 30% landed-cost screening threshold against its net selling price. Expressed as a percentage to one decimal place, what is that product's landed cost ratio?
For the magnetic car vent phone mount, one supplier claims certifications but has not been independently verified. What is that supplier's name?
Take the only product that currently passes every launch gate and run the default downside scenario against its stored base case. What is its pre-ad contribution in that downside scenario?
Two products fail the product-level evidence gate. One of them fails because its only recorded demand signal is supplier-controlled. What is that product's name?
One product has a negative target CAC, meaning its required profit per order exceeds its entire pre-ad contribution. What is that product's target CAC?
